$comment: Eval test cases for the spartacus-developer skill, following the agentskills.io evaluating-skills shape (skill_name + evals[] with id/prompt/expected_output/assertions). Two spartacus-specific extensions: `prompt_file` (the harness sends the .md verbatim to the LLM, so the prompt text lives there, not inline) and `targets` (pattern ids from the reference-file frontmatter, powering --skill/--pattern narrowing). `assertions` are human-readable checks; the LLM judge in ratings/spartacus-adherence.mjs is the primary grader, assertions document what 'good' looks like per task.

evals.expected_output: A recently-viewed carousel wired via CMS, tracking through Spartacus services, SSR-safe storage, OnPush + async, global SCSS.
assertions: Tracking reads/writes storage behind an SSR guard (isPlatformBrowser/WindowRef) or the component is marked disableSSR
Components declare ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush and use the async pipe
Styles live in global SCSS, not component styleUrls/inline styles

evals.expected_output: ProductListItemComponent extended (not copied) and remapped via cmsComponents in the correct injector.
assertions: Extends the Spartacus component class rather than copying its source
Remaps the CMS component type via provideConfig cmsComponents
Override is provided in the product feature's injector, not blindly in AppModule

evals.expected_output: Reuses the OOTB store-finder feature; no direct HttpClient, no Angular routes/loadChildren for CMS pages.
assertions: Uses the existing @spartacus/storefinder feature rather than building from scratch
No HttpClient injected in components/services
No loadChildren / RouterModule route for the CMS-managed page

evals.expected_output: Checkout extension using Commands/Queries + Adapter pipeline, provided in the checkout wrapper module.
assertions: Backend calls go through a Connector/Adapter pipeline, not HttpClient
State uses the Command/Query pattern matching checkout (not a bare BehaviorSubject)
Extension is provided in the checkout feature wrapper module

evals.expected_output: Quick-view modal wired via CMS/launch, styled with global SCSS, strings via cxTranslate.
assertions: Styles are global SCSS, not component-scoped
User-facing strings use the cxTranslate pipe
Rendered via CMS mapping or LaunchDialogService, not a raw Angular route

evals.expected_output: Full facade->connector->adapter pipeline, Commands/Queries, OnPush, global SCSS, i18n.
assertions: Full Facade -> Connector -> Adapter pipeline with OccEndpointsService
Components use OnPush + async pipe
Strings via cxTranslate; styles in global SCSS

evals.expected_output: Checkout step using Commands/Queries + Adapter, provideConfig, OnPush.
assertions: State uses Command/Query services, not a BehaviorSubject

Backend access via Adapter pipeline; component uses OnPush

evals.expected_output: CMS component with real placement on category pages, provideConfig, global SCSS.
